2. Key Legal Terms and Contract Clauses
A. Common Contract Clauses and Their Functions
"This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of England and Wales."
"Neither party shall be liable for delays caused by natural disasters."
"The Contractor agrees to indemnify the Client against all claims."
Ensures the contract remains valid even if part is unenforceable
"If any provision is found invalid, the remaining terms shall remain in effect."
States that the contract is the final agreement between parties
"This Agreement constitutes the entire agreement between the parties."
Defines how the contract can be ended
"Either party may terminate this Agreement upon 30 days’ written notice."
Match each clause with its function in a contract.
B. Key Legal Terminology in Contracts
An entity entering into a contract
"The parties agree to the terms outlined herein."
A legal duty imposed by a contract
"The seller has an obligation to deliver the goods within 10 days."
Failure to comply with contractual terms
"Late payment constitutes a breach of contract."
Something of value exchanged in a contract
"A valid contract requires consideration from both parties."
"Failure to enforce a term shall not constitute a waiver."

Rewrite the following legal phrases using
"This contract shall be deemed null and void if not signed by both parties."
"Without prejudice to the foregoing, the agreement remains binding."
"The parties hereto agree to the following terms."
B. Ambiguity and Precision in Contract Language
Legal English often includes redundant terms
acknowledge and agree, deem and consider
Some words have multiple legal meanings
assign = transfer rights OR designate responsibility
Identify potential translation issues in this sentence:
"The supplier shall provide goods in a timely manner and ensure compliance with industry standards."
4. Reading Practice: Contract Language in Context
Read the following contract excerpts aloud and analyze the legal terms used.
Text 1: Excerpt from a Supply Agreement

"The Supplier shall deliver the Goods in accordance with the specifications set forth in Schedule A. In the event of a delay, the Supplier must notify the Purchaser in writing. Failure to comply may constitute a material breach of this Agreement."
Text 2: Excerpt from a Service Agreement

"This Agreement shall commence on the Effective Date and remain in force until terminated by either Party. Termination requires 30 days’ written notice unless a breach of contract occurs. In such cases, immediate termination may apply."
